blocks.text: The page closes the Bhilowal campaign by remarking that although all of them had come to kill the Singhs, the would-be destroyers are themselves destroyed or scattered before the Khalsa charge.

The victors then shouted slogans of victory by reciting God’s name, and the result is lasting rather than local: the Singhs were now roaming fearlessly in Panjab, each Singh was equal in valour to one thousand, and the enemy could no longer contain them.
Before the scene ends, the narrative notes that the Singhs had disappeared along with huge war booty and then turns the reader across the threshold into Episode 90.
